description: Checks on the accessible outputs of 006.pdf (grandezas-e-medidas-42pgs.pdf, a 42-slide chemistry deck) that the object ground truth (ground_truth.csv) does not cover: text that must never reach a reader, slide structure, and what the pipeline must keep when a description fails. Patterns are Python regular expressions applied to the plain-text output (TXT, or text extracted from the PDF/UA), section by section, a section being the text from one 'Slide N de 42' heading to the next, unless 'scope' says 'document'.

must_not_match.pattern: Imagem sem descrição textual|Imagem detectada sem descricao textual|Image without a text description
must_not_match.why: the vision model left a picture without a description; v5 had ten slides like this

three or more short fragments each closed by '; ' with no space before it: the labels folded into an undescribed picture (#283 fallback). A printed list spaced as 'NaCl ; C ; Na' (slide 35) does not match
a drawn molecule transcribed as LaTeX (#284)
raw LaTeX that a screen reader reads letter by letter
the TXT table linearization in English under pt-BR
slide 5's prefix table collapsed into one row (#295)
slide 15's isotope table with every cell doubled (#295)
slide 37's text inside a slide 26 paragraph (#291)
slide 12's nuclide notation as a meaningless fragment (#293)

slide_heading.why: every slide opens with its own heading, before any picture (#293 kept a grown picture from moving above it)

slide_titles.title: Número Atômico / Número de Massa / Massa Atômica relativa/Massa Molar

structure.tables: ground_truth.csv rows of kind 'table' give each table's slide, rows, columns and header; 'table-header' and 'table-row' give its cells

chemical_structures_are_descriptions.why: a drawn molecule must be a described picture, never a formula block (#284)

slides_of_text_as_a_picture.why: a slide replaced by one picture of the whole slide must keep its text when the description fails (replaced_text)

degraded.description: What a run whose vision provider fails must still deliver. The 'text' kind of ground_truth.csv must appear even then, and the run must not be cached.
